title: M14 URL-trust benchmark dataset
description: Labeled ground-truth rows for the scripts/eval harness. Labels are publisher-signal tests: auditor_source + citation are required per row. Fetch failures are excluded from agreement, never scored as misses.

frozen.description: True once the labeled list is user-approved for spend-gated runs.

auditor_source.description: Which auditor rating the label comes from (e.g. MBFC-HIGH, Tranco, PhishTank, synthetic).

citation.description: Source citation for the label (URL or text reference).

notes.description: Optional context (e.g. expected attrition, article-level vs outlet-level).
